# 4 bedroom detached house for sale

> Situated in a quiet cul de sac location this good-sized detached house offers versatile living space, boasting a large kitchen/diner with double doors out to the rear garden. A work from home office is conveniently located on the ground floor and the large lounge benefits from a wood burning stove. Upstairs offers great sized bedrooms and a family bathroom.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bedrooms
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Lokalita: Marden Avenue, Chichester
- Cena: £550,000
